description: Cross-process dependencies of plx.process (requirements EXE-07, RSN-01, WS-09) over live captures: the L7 probe (scripts.ontology_projection_probe) makes a GET-only sync of the Portal reporting API into a throwaway mirror and one GET-only BC capture pass, projects them under the curated schema and lays them out as the served host state; then, offline and with no client, scripts.process_dependencies_probe runs plx.process through the served host (Host.served_tools) as its capture principal on sampled roots of every process graph stage that declares prerequisites (today the sales order's manufacturing step and the assembly order's realization): up to 200 roots per stage the reader's policy grants, lowest SHA-256 of the object id first, until 20 are open (the stage is not known reached). Recorded per stage: open roots by prerequisites state (clear, blocked, undecided); blocker entries by state and gap reason (dependency_not_pegged: a prerequisite linked by item, never met; dependency_unproven: a reached PO not received); blocker entries naming a record by source, split into proven_blockers (absent_in_source) and undecided_candidates (bc: BC POs the item path reached through the item's BC twin, a BC-only PO among them; a Portal PO and its BC twin are one entry), draft_records by source (reached POs in draft: not issued, neither blocker nor candidate), risks per stage (schedule risks of a prerequisite due after it is needed: proven, candidate, and undecided comparisons where a side has no one proven date), undecided_causes per stage (each undecided comparison by the side without one proven date, needed_by or available_by, and its cause: undated, withheld, unproven, disagreeing or staging_only; unclassified when its cause is not read), not_pegged per stage (each dependency_not_pegged entry by the live records it is about: open, a record read is not met; met, every live record is read and met; unread, records past the cap; unclassified when its detail is not read; a prerequisite reaching no live record has its reach's own entry instead) and roots with a BC-named entry. Pass = no contract failure, no process error, no clear answer over an unproven reach (clear_unproven: a clear stage not proven missing, or one with a prerequisite linked by item only), the budget holds and at least 5 roots are open. A Portal outage blocks parts, not the check: the build reports blocked_upstream and the answers run over BC (blocked, never a pass); with no record source the probe names sources_blocked. Counts, booleans, process and stage names, gap reasons and source names only; never a value, key, identifier or citation. Live-unverified until the live check records a result.
notes: Registered, live-unverified: no live-check result yet. Module test: injected-transport (verify/tests/test_live_process_dependencies.py runs this spec's own argv over the fixture world with the Portal and BC transports injected and checks it with live_verify.check_expectations; only the live size floor and the live-read label may miss there). Each non-present stage also carries its plain `reading` (kind and text); contract_failures 0 holds its shape over the live answers, and the probe does not yet count its kinds. Denominators are recorded, not asserted: an undecided share is data for the EXE-07/RSN-01/WS-09 rows, never a pass or a failure; a material prerequisite is linked by item (Portal pegs no PO to an order), so it is never clear by design. The reader is the served host's capture principal under examples/projection_probe_audience.live-check.json with no marking held. Timing (forecast, unmeasured): the build shares the ontology.mentions budget (2,600 s); the answers get 900 s for at most 400 plx.process calls; the first run measures seconds. Session projection (2026-10-11T01:41Z stopped budget_exhausted in projection_build after 2,611 s): it requires ontology.session_projection, its session producer of {session_state}/projection (Portal and BC, service reader), which never blocks it, and runs the L7 build with --build-only (one build, no rebuild or claim checks, which it never read): when this session committed that generation and every unit key matches it opens it read-only (session_projection.mode reused: no sync, BC capture or projection); else it builds cold as before (mode cold). Disk (owner order 42ad51823f9c): its mirror is the session's {session_state}/mirror.sqlite (mirror.full_coverage's store, never a cold copy in {tmp}); both session paths are session_reads, so its failure or timeout never spoils them for the next consumer; a cold build first checks the free space it needs (error disk_insufficient with need_bytes and free_bytes, no build) and the build's disk.peak is recorded.
